translations.text: Keep the pattern of sound words that you heard from me, in the faith and love that are in Christ Jesus.
Understand what I am saying. May the Lord give you understanding in everything.
Make every effort to present yourself approved before God, a worker with no cause for shame, correctly handling the word of truth.
They have strayed from the truth and say that the resurrection of the dead has already taken place, and they overturn the faith of some.
If anyone cleanses himself from such things, he will be a vessel for honorable use, made holy and useful to his Master, prepared for every good work.
Traitors, reckless, arrogant, lovers of pleasure rather than lovers of God.
From now on, the crown of righteousness is kept for me, which the Lord, the righteous Judge, will award me on that day—not only to me, but also to all who have loved his appearing.
May the Lord rescue me from every evil work and bring me safely into his kingdom in heaven. To him be glory forever and ever. Amen.
Greet Prisca and Aquila and the household of Onesiphorus.
